notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Steam Achievements:
Unlock a new level of bragging rights with our Stage Completion Achievements! Conquer every stage and earn your badge of honor on Steam. Prove you're the ultimate master of the game!

Global High Score:
Get ready to take on the world! We're rolling out the Global High Score Leaderboard where you can pit your skills against players from every corner of the globe. Climb to the top and show everyone who the real champion is!

Stay tuned for these exciting updates coming soon!
